name: Compact Octree Memory Layout
definition: A memory layout for voxel octree nodes that packs validity and leaf status into 2 bytes and uses relative pointers, with support for far pointers via a separate indirection entry to handle large address spaces.
summary: Compact Octree Memory Layout packs validity and leaf status into two bytes using relative pointers, distinguishing itself by supporting far pointers via indirection for large address spaces.
